title: Premium payment due
description: A WhatsApp premium reminder for insurers with amount, due date and pay link, so policies do not lapse. Utility category.
notes: Mention the grace period if one exists; it explains the urgency without sounding promotional. Send 5 days and 1 day before due date.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your premium of *{{amount}}* for policy {{policy_no}} is due on {{due_date}}. Pay before then to keep your coverage active.
